description.biologydictionary: A strange book whose cover looks a bit like a biology textbook...
config.biologydictionary.title: Biology Dictionary Config
config.biologydictionary.entry.screenSca: Adjusts Biology Dictionary screens without affecting vanilla UI scale.
config.biologydictionary.entry.firstPers: Where shoulder entities are rendered in first-person view.
config.biologydictionary.entry.hideEntit: Hide the description widget when no entity description data exists.
config.biologydictionary.entry.bookItemR: If disabled, survival players may open the screen without the item.
config.biologydictionary.entry.bookItemO: If disabled, survival has no built-in way to obtain the item.
config.biologydictionary.entry.inheritSi: If enabled, babies inherit silent state when both parents are silent.
config.biologydictionary.entry.allowStea: Allows players to steal items from other players. Disabled by default.
config.biologydictionary.entry.discovery: Defines how a player discovers new entities.
config.biologydictionary.entry.allowOver: Allows viewing and using skills on undiscovered entities.
config.biologydictionary.entry.telescope: Maximum range in blocks for telescope discovery.
config.biologydictionary.entry.discovery: Opening detail screen may discover the entity when supported by the strategy.
Highlighting may discover the entity when supported by the strategy.
Looking through a telescope may discover entities when supported by the strategy.
Interacting may discover the entity when supported by the strategy.
Killing may discover the entity when supported by the strategy.
Being killed may discover the entity when supported by the strategy.
config.biologydictionary.entry.skillCost: Skill cost map. Edit the YAML file directly.
